### 🛡️ Quality, Security & Governance Gates

Please verify each gate before requesting human review:

- [ ] **Static Analysis & Typecheck**: Passed without compilation errors (`npm run test:run` / `mvn test-compile`).
- [ ] **DevSecOps Security Scan**: Verified 0 critical secrets, 0 hardcoded keys, 0 unescaped injections.
- [ ] **AI Change Trust Score**: Calculated and meets deployment threshold ($\ge 85/100$).
- [ ] **Human Review Approval**: Required prior to merging into protected branch.
